title: Payment Service 500 Spike after v2.1.2 deploy
symptoms: Spike in HTTP 500 errors and DB connection timeout alerts immediately following deployment.
root_cause: Database connection pool size was inadvertently lowered from 50 to 5 in application configuration.
resolution: Rolled back deployment to v2.1.1, restoring previous pool size. Service recovered in 3 minutes.

title: Checkout Gateway 504 Gateway Timeout during flash sale
symptoms: Downstream payment gateway Stripe responded with elevated latency > 8000ms causing timeouts.
root_cause: External payment provider experienced partial regional degradation.
resolution: Enabled circuit breaker and temporarily routed backup traffic to Adyen gateway.

title: Database Connection Pool Exhaustion on Postgres Primary
symptoms: All services unable to acquire database connection: 'FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved'.
root_cause: An unindexed analytics batch query opened hundreds of idle in transaction connections.
resolution: Terminated idle connections using pg_terminate_backend and added connection timeout limit.

title: Payment Service Memory Leak on v1.9.8
symptoms: Pods restarted with OOMKilled error code 137 repeatedly every 30 minutes.
root_cause: Unbounded cache in memory storing deserialized JWT tokens without TTL.
resolution: Applied hotfix v1.9.9 with LRU cache eviction and restarted payment pods.

title: PayGate Upstream Outage - Unrelated UI deploy mistargeted
symptoms: HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout on checkout. Engineers initially suspected a recent button copy deploy, but rolling back did not resolve 504 errors.
root_cause: Primary third-party gateway (PayGate) experienced an upstream cloud outage. Internal database, memory, and CPU were completely healthy.
resolution: Escalated incident to vendor status desk and enabled secondary fallback payment provider (StripeSecondary). Error rate dropped from 45% to <1%. Caution: Never roll back an unrelated UI/copy change when internal metrics are healthy and errors are upstream timeouts.

title: Postgres Read Replica Lag Causing Stale Account Verification 500s
symptoms: HTTP 500 InternalServerError on account verification calls. Outage began 10m after deploy v2.3.5.
root_cause: Database replica db-replica-02 suffered 500s replication lag due to disk I/O contention, causing queries to read nonexistent newly-created records. The recent deploy was an unrelated analytics tracking tag.
resolution: Engineers initially considered rolling back, but low confidence and conflicting logs revealed the true cause. SRE failed over the lagging replica (failover_replica) and drained traffic to healthy replica db-replica-01. Service recovered immediately.
